report:
Behavior — A canonical, valid archive Git worktree whose `archive.repositoryRoot` contains credential-shaped text must fail closed. The Recorder must return exit 125 / `invalid-config` with `child.status: not-spawned`, allocate no archive stage, spawn no child, publish no docket/manifest, and never substitute or persist a redacted archive identity. An equivalent clean archive remains successful.

Owner — Extend the existing credential-free structural-metadata gate in `src/recorder/config.ts`: after `requireCanonicalGitWorktree(...)` returns the canonical `archive.repositoryRoot`, pass that canonical identity through `requireCredentialFreeMetadata(...)`. This is the pre-side-effect config seam; `runRecorder` loads config before destination handling, scratch/stage allocation, declaration admission, or `spawnOnce`. Do not add a scanner, manifest rewrite, or run-time parallel gate.

Red — Add a black-box Recorder regression beside the existing structural-metadata / Git-reference identity coverage. Create a real archive worktree beneath a credential-shaped path component, configure valid authority/task references and a valid docket, and prove current HEAD incorrectly reaches child spawn and promotion. The failing oracle must check the spawn counter, `child.status`, absence of final docket/manifest, and absence of `.ak/work` stage residue; diagnostics must not expose the credential text.

Green — The toxic canonical archive root is rejected at config loading with the existing credential-shaped metadata error family, spawn count remains unchanged, no stage or promoted core exists, and no redacted replacement `repositoryRoot` is persisted anywhere. A clean-path control using the same fixture family spawns exactly once and publishes a manifest whose archive identity is the unchanged canonical clean root.

Scope — Modify only the existing config gate and focused Recorder regression(s), with any test-harness adjustment strictly limited to constructing the archive under the toxic path. Preserve scanner rules, canonical-worktree validation, declaration admission, archive layout, manifest schema/redaction behavior, child protocol, promotion, CLI contract, README, schemas, and Souls. Do not inspect sessions. Apply should run the focused Recorder test, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test`, then create one forward commit titled `fix(recorder): gate canonical archive identity` and return the completed Receipt with its SHA.
